entries.title: Jeremiah 1:1
segments: Anathoth; a town three or four miles north of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:5
segments: When the church has need of any service, God raises up and qualifies men for it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:6
segments: Humility is essential as a preparation for God's service; but we should be careful that it do not degenerate into timidity, and thus hinder us from discharging the work that he assigns to us.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:7
segments:
vv 7-10. 
 
God's ministers should not shrink from any duty that he lays upon them, however arduous and dangerous; but faithfully perform it, assured of his constant presence and help.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:10
segments: To root out--to plant; to declare my purpose to do so.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:11
segments:
vv 11-12. 
 
  An almond-tree--hasten;in the original Hebrew, the words "almond- tree" and "hasten" are the same.  There is also an allusion to the fact that the almond-tree is the earliest tree to blossom and bear fruit in the spring.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:13
segments:
A seething-pot; literally, "a pot blown," that is, having under it a blown fire, which causes it to boil violently.  This is a figure of God's wrath to be executed on the Jews by the Babylonians. 
 
  Toward the north; or, "from the face of the north," is preperable. This represents the seething-pot itself as coming from the north.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:14
segments: Out of the north; though the Babylonians and their allies were to the east of Judea, yet they always entered the land from the north.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:17
segments: To be afraid of God's enemies is the way to bring ourselves into subjection to them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 1:18
segments: vv 18-19. Though the wicked may persecute and distress, they can never destroy those whom God protects and helps.
